proposedRules.healingGoldBasis: Linear patient work after throughput, before volume discount and order rounding; not minimum single-patient wall-clock duration
proposedRules.healingEstimateAssumption: Full hospital throughput dedicated to these battle casualties; existing treatment queue waiting is not modeled
proposedRules.goldDiscountAppliesTo: Marginal quantities of the same unit type and forge cohort in one order
proposedRules.allTroopAvailabilityRequirements: Must come from production catalog; no training unlock inferred from wall repairs.

rounding.resources: ceil(baseResource * resourceFactor) per unit, then multiply by count
rounding.queueSeconds: ceil(raw duration) once per type/cohort job, then sum jobs in one building
rounding.gold: ceil(raw discounted gold) once per type/cohort order
rounding.woundEligibility: round half up of 60% of total human casualties, then proportional integer allocation
